description:
Response body for POST /api/v1/predict.

Forward-compatible with future META-V22-active responses:
base_prob / meta_prob / meta_learner_version / meta_skipped_reason
are Optional. Current xgb_v2-only production responses populate
base_prob == win_probability and meta_skipped_reason="no_meta_artifact".

schema_version.description: Envelope minor version (per D-03; URL is major).
schema_version.title: Schema Version

base_prob.description: Raw XGBoost probability before meta-learner wrapping.
base_prob.title: Base Prob

meta_prob.description: Meta-learner output probability; None when meta is skipped.
meta_prob.title: Meta Prob

meta_learner_version.description: Meta-learner version (e.g., 'v22.1') when meta is active; None otherwise.
meta_learner_version.title: Meta Learner Version

meta_skipped_reason.description: Reason meta was skipped (e.g., 'no_meta_artifact'); None when meta is active.
meta_skipped_reason.title: Meta Skipped Reason

gate_contract_ref.description: Path/version of gate contract used at prediction time (e.g., '.planning/gate_contract_v2.3.json'). Phase 32 D-04 (PARTNER-V23-01).
gate_contract_ref.title: Gate Contract Ref

model_candidates.description: Supported model candidates with byte-identity SHAs. Each entry: {name: str, sha256: str, phase: str}. Phase 32 D-04 (PARTNER-V23-01).
model_candidates.title: Model Candidates

phase_chain_audit_sha.description: AUDIT-01 chain leaf SHA (xgb_v2.joblib byte-identity). Phase 32 D-04 (PARTNER-V23-01).
phase_chain_audit_sha.title: Phase Chain Audit Sha

title: PredictorOutputV1
